registered_before: final controlled A/B/C and final matrix; initial baseline/development B was already inspected

metrics.semantic_material_consistency: All three section mesh techniques must have identical neutral/focus colors and alpha; every neutral shell uses its full-scene role.
metrics.palette_exceptions: 0 scene-id/family-id palette branches in product changes; engineering invisibility/warmup constants are not palette exceptions.
metrics.geometry_identity: Fixture hash, scene/state hashes and unchanged backend/model/chart/camera/classifier trees; full frontend geometry tree independently locked by Git product identity.
metrics.frame_and_panel_overlap: Default camera equals baseline within 1e-9; analysis panel overlap = 0 in sampled default desktop/compact states; report any existing deficit instead of reclassifying it.
metrics.occlusion: Baseline vs final normal default edge IDs/spans/dashes unchanged; independent two-sided opaque-wall probes: Normal blocked=0 pixels, Normal front>0, X-ray blocked>0.
metrics.section_own_pixels: On/off same-frame pixels with RGB L1 delta >8; report counts/fractions per fill and normal/orbit/X-ray. Visible section expectation is positive in at least one meaningful normal/orbit camera; explicit foreground occlusion may yield zero.
metrics.edge_stability: Selection changes emphasis, not baseline default-camera hidden/visible span signatures; X-ray leaves classifier/dash semantics intact.
metrics.label_readability: Report visible label CSS colors, font size and pairwise rectangle collisions; all visible labels >=12 CSS px; browser text contrast evaluated against actual label background where resolvable, UNKNOWN otherwise.
metrics.selection: Selected id must be non-null; pixel/style emphasis differs from neutral; no numeric answer annotation on Mode A entry.
metrics.reproducibility: Identical fixture/camera/viewport/state for comparisons; report full screenshot hashes and RGB differences; no aesthetic score inferred.
metrics.css_variables: Existing tokens tests plus static scan of production CSS/TS/TSX; unresolved count 0 excluding declared runtime properties.
metrics.performance: Raw orbit durations, occlusion p50/p95, draw/program/memory counts, first-use allocations and repeated-sweep allocations. Encountered material styles must not allocate repeatedly. SwiftShader is not physical-device FPS.
metrics.visibility_transitions: Actual hide/isolate/reset and backward timeline controls on multi-solid, cone and prism; remaining secondary shell must retain neutral color and opacity after selection cleared. Missing targets or null probes are failures, not zero.

forbidden_inferences: Automated assertions do not grant human aesthetic approval
Offline scenes do not prove live NLU E2E
114 measured files do not hash the full frontend renderer
